device.model: ROS 1 Gazebo quadcopter application with a results recorder
device.name: quad_sim indoor quadcopter simulation

facts.text: The Results constructor calls rospy.init_node('quad_results') and creates subscribers on /ground_truth_to_tf/pose (PoseStamped), /move_base/status (GoalStatusArray) and /results_saver (Empty).
The Results module imports geometry_msgs PoseStamped and actionlib_msgs GoalStatusArray.
pose_cb stores the previous and current PoseStamped samples and calls set_total_dist only while isActive is true.
get_delta_dist computes the planar Euclidean distance from the previous and current pose position x and y.
set_total_dist adds the get_delta_dist result to total_dist.
status_cb reads status_list[0], records its goal_id stamp seconds as init_time, sets isActive when the status is not 3 and sets isComplete when the status is 3.
After completion status_cb calls set_elapsed_time, set_avg_speed, append_df and reset_params, then increments GOAL_NUM.
set_elapsed_time subtracts init_time from final_time and set_avg_speed divides total_dist by elapsed_time.
create_df declares the columns Goal, Final Position, Elapsed Time, Distance Traveled and Average Speed.
append_df writes the rounded final position, elapsed time, total distance and average speed into the dataframe.
save_results_cb writes the dataframe to the literal path ~/catkin_ws/src/quadcopter_sim/quadcopter_results/src/Results.csv when /results_saver receives an Empty message.
The Results constructor creates rospy.Subscriber objects, creates a rospy.Rate(5) and then calls rospy.spin; it creates no ROS service server.
The take-off/land node subscribes to /move_base/feedback, /cmd_vel, /ground_truth_to_tf/pose and /quadcopter_land, and creates a Twist publisher on /cmd_vel.
The take-off/land node advertises a Twist publisher on /cmd_vel with queue size 1.
The teleoperation node advertises a Twist publisher on /cmd_vel with queue size 5.
The results launch starts quadcopter_results.py as the quad_results node.
The quadcopter launch includes gazebo_ros/launch/empty_world.launch with the school world and spawns the hector quadrotor model.
The navigation documentation instructs the operator to publish /quadcopter_land at 5 Hz as std_msgs/Empty.
The project index describes mapping with gmapping or cartographer and autonomous navigation with move_base.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned responses with no physics step, pacing or state-hash replay; the same placeholder message is returned on every subscription

gaps: the fake is a ROS-free canned transport: it answers the declared /ground_truth_to_tf/pose and /move_base/status subscriptions and runs no Gazebo physics, PX4 SITL, MAVROS, gmapping, cartographer, move_base, TF or wall-clock loop
all pose, orientation, stamp and goal-status values are placeholders and do not establish a trajectory, sensor frame, navigation outcome or timing

the results node computes planar distance, elapsed time and average speed in process and writes a CSV to a hard-coded home-directory path; this package observes the input topics but does not read the CSV and does not reproduce those calculations
the upstream status_list length is not fixed by the clone; the fake returns one placeholder GoalStatus entry

the upstream Results constructor creates a rospy.Rate(5) that the node never sleeps on and then calls rospy.spin, so its callbacks run on message arrival; the fake answers each subscription once with one canned message

no motion, takeoff, landing, teleoperation, navigation, mapping, PX4/MAVROS command or move_base goal is bound, and no acknowledged stop, pause, step or reset endpoint exists in the pinned source; /cmd_vel, /quadcopter_land and /results_saver are not exposed
the fake does not model ROS parameters, QoS, namespaces, remapping, TF, the move_base action protocol, Gazebo contacts or the full live message arrays

measures.description: Read one fresh geometry_msgs/PoseStamped sample from the Results node's /ground_truth_to_tf/pose subscription. The action returns the wire pose and header; it does not compute distance and does not claim a trajectory.
measures.name: read_ground_truth_pose

measures.description: Read one fresh actionlib_msgs/GoalStatusArray sample from the Results node's /move_base/status subscription. The action returns the wire status list; it does not reach a goal and does not claim navigation completion.
measures.name: read_goal_status

safe_state.description: No actuation is bound: the results and take-off/land nodes expose only ROS topics and no acknowledged stop service or action, so an MHS e-stop is the runtime software latch and commands no native stop. Gazebo and the simulated quadcopter keep running under whatever publishes /cmd_vel (the take-off/land hover loop, teleoperation or move_base).
